layout.grid: Tetris (Mode A) for products, wide gaps (gap-8 md:gap-12)
layout.borderRadius: rounded-none or max rounded-sm for a sharp, editorial high-fashion look

motion.hoverEffects: Image scale-105, subtle glowing border on cards, text color shift to primary

components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none), transparent bg with 1px primary border or solid primary with dark text. Use 'tracing beam' or hover glow effects.
components.cards: Flash card style. Glassmorphism or solid surface with 1px border. On hover, apply subtle shadow and border glow.
components.modals: Shadcn Dialog. Dark glassmorphism background (backdrop-blur-2xl bg-black/80).
components.navigation: Sticky nav. backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60. 1px border-b border-white/10.

images.description: Close up view of sheer dark luxury fabric for the main hero section background. Use with bg-black/50 overlay.
Black silk/net fabric for the Net category.
Blue and white floral textile for Embroidered Nets.
Red/burgundy satin texture for Satin category.
Dark blue fabric with soft light reflections for Georgette category.
Patterned elegant fabric for Organza category.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML + Tailwind for major sections to ensure creative layouts, especially for the bento product grids and hero section.
Apply 'Cormorant Garamond' via Google Fonts for all headings, keep tracking tight. Apply 'Outfit' for body text.
Implement Shadcn UI for the Contact Form, Mobile Drawer (Sheet), and Product detail modal. Strip the vercel-look and replace with dark premium styling (sharp corners, minimal borders).

Flash card styles for products: Use aspect-[3/4] tall cards for products. On hover, the image scales up (scale-105), and a subtle glowing gold border appears. Optionally hide product details in default state and slide them up on hover.
Add Lenis for smooth scrolling. Wrap main elements in Framer Motion variants for elegant fade-up animations on scroll.
Ensure the sticky header uses a crystal glass effect: backdrop-blur-xl, bg-black/60, and a delicate 1px border-white/10.
Data-testid attributes MUST be added to all interactive elements for testing.
